summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Mikilab / Il Maestro del Pane. Backend: 15 pytest cases (health, recipes CRUD + mikilab seed idempotency, personal-collection emptiness, oven-profiles CRUD, 404/422 validation, Maestro SSE streaming chat + history) - all 15 PASSED. Frontend (mobile 390x844): bottom nav 3-way switching, Mikilab seeded 3 example recipes, recipe create/edit/delete with confirm, hydration auto-calc (1000g/780g -> 78%), Maestro hub 4 tools, personal recipe list empty (no examples), Calcola gradi formula 4*25-(20+22+5+21)=32C correct, Pianifica backward timeline correct (12h total, start lun 06:00 -> infornata lun 18:00, NO freezer references anywhere in code or UI), Gestione forno profile creation with working phase timers (15:00 counted down to 14:58) + delete, AI chat streamed a real Italian reply token-by-token, Enciclopedia (2 news + 4 encyclopedia), Video (2 valid youtube.com/embed iframes), Stoccarda (2 announcements). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Update drops all None values, so fields cannot be cleared. Verified: PUT with water_grams=null, hydration_percent=null left stored values at 700 / 70. RecipeDialog sends null for emptied numeric inputs, so clearing 'Acqua (g)' or removing hydration in the UI silently keeps stale data. Use payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) instead of filtering None.

Prior turns are re-sent as a text 'context_prefix' on every request in addition to LlmChat's own session; last 10 turns get resent each time (token cost grows, potential duplicated context). Consider relying only on LlmChat session history.

If the LLM stream raises mid-generation, the assistant message is never persisted and no error event is emitted to the client (stream just ends); wrap the generator in try/except and yield an SSE error chunk.

ui_bugs.issue: Input is only w-16 with right-aligned mono font; fractional values like 0.25 render visually truncated as '0.2' (value is correct, display is clipped).
React console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y).
load() has no try/catch and no loading/error state; a failing GET /api/oven-profiles causes an unhandled promise rejection and a permanently empty list with no user feedback.
Phase name inputs and the 'Aggiungi fase' / 'Rimuovi' buttons have no data-testid, making phase add/remove hard to test.

issues: Uses the browser-native <input type='datetime-local'> picker instead of a shadcn calendar/time component - inconsistent with the rest of the design system and inconsistent across browsers.
YouTube iframes render as black boxes until interaction (no poster/thumbnail placeholder); embeds are valid youtube.com/embed URLs, but a lightweight thumbnail-first load would look better on mobile.
Phase list has no reset-to-defaults action after editing/removing phases; state is lost on tool navigation (no persistence of the plan).

action_items: Fix PUT /api/recipes/{id} to honour explicitly-sent nulls (exclude_unset=True) so users can clear numeric fields/hydration.
Add try/catch + loading/error state to GestioneForno.load().
Widen the Pianifica phase-hours input so 0.25 is fully visible.
Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to RecipeDialog to clear the a11y warning.
Optional: emit an SSE error chunk if the Maestro LLM stream fails.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_recipe: filtering out None makes PATCH semantics lossy - confirmed data bug, use exclude_unset.
maestro_stream: no exception handling around chat.stream_message; a provider error loses the assistant turn and leaves the client stream truncated with no [DONE].
GestioneForno.jsx: unguarded async load() (unhandled rejection) and no error UI, unlike RecipeList which handles it correctly.
PianificaProduzione: computed plan is component-local only; nothing is persisted to backend, so a refresh loses the schedule (acceptable if by design, but worth confirming with product intent).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (4 minor UI/a11y issues noted)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeded 3 mikilab example recipes automatically. All test data created (TEST_ prefixed recipes and oven profiles) was deleted after testing; personal collection and oven-profiles left empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (15 cases, ~13s, includes a live Claude Sonnet 4.6 SSE streaming test). Frontend flows all verified once via Playwright at 390x844: nav, Mikilab recipe CRUD + hydration, Maestro 4 tools (aggiungi/pianifica/gradi/forno incl. running timer), sa-tutto chat streaming + 4 tabs. Verified NO freezer/congelatore string anywhere in /app/frontend/src or server.py. Remaining known bug: PUT /api/recipes drops nulls (cannot clear fields) - retest that specific case after the fix.
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/recipes/{id} builds updates via {k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump().items() if v is not None}. Because RecipeDialog converts empty numeric inputs to null, those keys are stripped and the old values remain in Mongo. Repro: POST a recipe with water_grams=700, then PUT {water_grams: null} -> GET still returns 700. Mitigation: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) with the client sending only changed keys.
